text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Madison Group is constructing a residential development (Nobu Residences) consisting of two 45-storey condominium buildings at 15-35 Mercer Street. The site is located midway on Mercer Street, between John Street and Blue Jays Way. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the south sidewalk and a portion of the westbound lane on Mercer Street abutting the site to accommodate a construction staging area for the development. With the construction staging area in place, the existing one-way westbound traffic operations will be maintained. The east-west pedestrian movements on the south side of Mercer Street will be restricted during daily work hours. Traffic control persons will be required…

Approved closure of the south sidewalk on Mercer Street, between a point 46.8 metres west of John Street and a point 86.2 metres further west, from July 20, 2018 to May 31, 2020. 2. Approved closure of a 3.3 metre wide portion of the westbound lane on the south side of Mercer Street, between a point 46.8 metres west of John Street and a point 66.2 metres further west, from July 20, 2018 to May 31, 2022. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Mercer Street, between a point 89.5 metres east of Blue Jays Way and a point 53.6 metres west of John Street. 4.
